facts: Test fixture adapted from approved V4. Not a saved Upwork job.
Migrate our existing database from Kit.
Connect Skool workshops with GoHighLevel for email capture, automated reminders and follow-ups.
We plan to run public paid workshops every 3 weeks through Skool and need someone who can help us manage and reuse simple automations, troubleshoot issues and provide occasional technical support.

close.title: Measure each workshop.
close.caption: Track preparation time, reminder coverage, and attendance across each workshop cycle.

metrics.name: Preparation time per workshop
metrics.definition: Total active staff minutes spent preparing the form, event details, registration checks, email sequence, and pre-event test for each workshop. Exclude initial system setup and workshop content creation.

metrics.name: Reminder coverage
metrics.definition: Verified workshop registrants due a reminder who receive a delivery-confirmed reminder divided by all verified registrants due that reminder. Report ineligible or suppressed recipients separately without overriding their preferences.

metrics.name: Attendance rate
metrics.aim: Bring more registrants into the workshop
metrics.definition: Verified workshop registrants recorded as attending divided by all verified registrants for that workshop, multiplied by 100. Apply the same agreed cancellation cutoff and attendance definition to each event.
